entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Alex, I want to return this VeloBand. It's ridiculous. I need my money back, now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference! I just don't like it. Honestly, it was a total impulse buy, I thought I'd use it, but I don't use it at all. I simply changed my mind.
Okay, I understand. Can I get your order number so I can pull up your account details?

It's VF-8675309. Look, I've had it for a few weeks, and I want a refund. Don't try to tell me to sell it on some resale marketplace because that's not happening. I bought it from you, you're taking it back. Simple.

I hear your frustration. Thank you for that order number. One moment while I review your purchase history... Okay, I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. Let me just check our policy on that for you.

There's nothing to check! A customer isn't happy, you give them their money back! If you can't do this for me right now, put me on with a manager who can. I'm already writing a one-star review in my head, Alex.
That won't be necessary. I've just checked the policy, and you're all set. The item is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can process this return for you immediately.
Oh. So... you're just going to take it back? No problem?

That's correct. No problem at all. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Well... okay. Good. That's what I expected. And I'll get a full refund?
Yes, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method as soon as we receive the item, which typically takes 3-5 business days to process. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
